mapper.select: SELECT id, title, summary, content, publish_date FROM `mini_news` WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY publish_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT * FROM `mini_news` WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `mini_news` (title, summary, content, publish_date, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{publishDate}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `mini_news` SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE `mini_news` SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
